title: Dynamic contractual gap analysis workflow for customer security questionnaires
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an automated workflow that converts incoming customer security and vendor questionnaires (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA) into a prioritized contractual gap analysis and recommended remediation plan, then routes to the correct owners with SLAs and escalation policies.
objective: Reduce time-to-first-response for enterprise security asks from days to <24 hours, provide deterministic prioritization for high-risk contractual items, and create auditable handoffs between Sales, Legal, Trust, and Eng.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming questionnaire documents (PDF/Word/URL) are automatically ingested and parsed with >85% accuracy on control extraction for common templates
Extracted obligations mapped to Redwood control taxonomy (privacy, encryption, data residency, incident response, subprocessing) and presented in a gap view
Risk score assigned per obligation using defined scoring rubric and surfaced to reviewer
Automated routing rules send items to assigned team (Legal/Trust/Infra/PM) with SLA and escalation if no ack within SLA
UI shows recommended contractual language or remediation playbook per gap, with exportable summary for customer response
Audit log retained for each questionnaire with timestamps, reviewers, and decisions for 12 months
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight processing pipeline in Console: 1) ingestion microservice that accepts questionnaire artifacts, 2) hybrid extractor (rule templates + LLM-assisted entity extraction) to create a normalized obligations list, 3) mapping layer to Redwood control taxonomy, 4) scoring engine that applies configurable risk weights, and 5) routing/orchestration engine that creates tasks with SLA and escalation policies. Surface results in a new "Questionnaire Response" panel in the Compliance section of Console and provide one-click 'export response' for Sales/SEs.
tradeoffs: LLM-assisted extraction improves coverage but may introduce hallucination—mitigate with conservative confidence thresholds and human review
Building full natural language understanding for arbitrary questionnaire formats is expensive; prioritize top 5 vendor questionnaires and common templates first
Strict automation reduces turnaround time but increases risk of incorrect contractual commitments—keep legal sign-off in high-risk categories
Storing parsed questionnaire data centrally increases auditability but raises data retention and access control considerations for Private deployments
stakeholders: Engineering: Marco Chen (Backend lead), Lena Rodriguez (Frontend)
updates: 2026-03-10: Created initial proposal after intake with Sales (ACME Corp). Collected 6 anonymized questionnaires for template analysis.
